cards.name: Choice of Damnations
cards.oracleText: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many permanents of their choice.

cards.name: Choice of Fortunes
cards.oracleText:
Seek two cards. You may shuffle them into your library. If you do, seek two cards.
You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
